title: ON THE DISTANCE TO DISCRIMINANTS AND OSCULATING VARIETIES
summary: We study the problem of finding the closest singular hypersurface to a given nonsingular one from algebro-geometric point of view. The set of singular hypersurfaces $Ξ$ of a given degree is a projective variety dual to the Veronese variety. However, as was shown by Raffalli [Raf14], the Bombieri-Weyl (also known as apolar) distance from a general real hypersurface to $Ξ$ could be minimized at a singular point of $Ξ$.
